doc: The colour doctrine as tokens (D4 Ink and Hatch). The world is a black-and-white baseline: ink, paper and the charcoal / wash greys. Two accent inks appear rarely and only on their allowed uses. look_d4 and look_d4_item print paper / wash / ink from these tokens (look_profiles.json tones; print_part still carries its own constants); PaletteTokens.classify() uses the gates below, which mirror look_d4 plates(): a pixel is vermilion when r - max(g, b) >= verm_gate, teal when min(g, b) - r >= teal_gate (0..1 channels). dev/selftest/accent_audit.gd counts accent pixels per render layer against these.

tokens.doc: the cream paper: pavements, roofs, the sticker rim
the ink: lines, hatching, the darkest wash
steel and robots before the print (look_d4_item STEEL)
